name: Elena Varo
bio: Elena trained as an architect before moving into sales, and still reads every listing as a set of drawings first. She handles Velora's cliff-top villas and new-build commissions along the Capo Lume headland.

name: Matteo Lind
bio: Matteo grew up in Portalba's harbour quarter and knows which terraces catch the evening sun. He specialises in sea-view apartments and penthouses for buyers relocating to the coast.

name: Sofia Arnaud
bio: Sofia runs Velora's lettings desk, from seasonal villa rentals to long-term apartment leases. She is known for clear contracts and for answering every enquiry the same day.

name: Julien Ferro
bio: Julien covers the stone villages inland, where restored farmhouses sit beside contemporary homes in the olive groves. He works closely with local surveyors on renovation projects.

name: Amara Okafor
bio: Amara advises buyers on off-plan and recently completed homes, translating specifications and energy ratings into plain language. She manages Velora's apartment launches in Riva Celeste.

name: Luca Benedetti
bio: Luca handles discreet sales and viewings for private clients, often arranged around a single weekend visit. He coordinates with lawyers and notaries from first viewing to completion.
